name: Willing to work but not employed by the employer’s own fault or an obstacle it could have avoided — wage paid

pay.name: Work suspension: unpaid days

references.title: UU 13/2003 arts.93, 145 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/fulltext/2003/13TAHUN2003UU.htm); PP 36/2021 art.40 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP362021.pdf): a suspended working day keeps the monthly wage when its kind pays it; otherwise the day of the wage (basic plus fixed allowances ÷ the days of the month, as an unpaid day: NO_PAY_LEAVE) is deducted.

pay.eligibility:
work.days.exists(
  d,
  has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null && d.day_type == "WORK"
)

name: Natural disaster or another obstacle the employer could not avoid — no work, no wage

references.title: UU 13/2003 art.93(1); PP 36/2021 art.40(1) — UU 13/2003 (https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/fulltext/2003/13TAHUN2003UU.htm); PP 36/2021 (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/asset/data_puu/PP362021.pdf)

name: Lawful strike over normative rights the employer seriously violated — wage paid
Any other strike — no work, no wage
